reviews.title: Flight in a tiny Bombardier
reviews.text: This aircraft had around 12 seats; it was so tiny that it was impossible to put a cabin luggage in the overhead locker. It has been put below the seat in front. Everything went fine.
reviews.author: Francis N

reviews.title: I liked them for my Annual Tambov Trip
reviews.text: I travel them once in a year while visiting to Tambov, as my son studies there. Good and perfect service. No complaint. Earlier they used to operate from DME, now they operate from VKO, this change is beyond my understanding...
reviews.author: Subrata

reviews.title: Fast flight between Tallinn and St. Petersburg
reviews.text: It was much better and more comfortable than spending long hours in bus or train. The flights between Tallinn and St. Petersburg were stopped.
reviews.author: personne551

reviews.title: Not reliable airline! Be careful!
reviews.text: Do not book from this airline. I buyed my ticket but after a month I was notified that my flight has been cancelled without any clear reason. They refunded me but I lost 35 euros due to exchange rate changes in Russian currency. I asked for a compensation but they rejected my request with unacceptable argument. They cancelled the flight! why I should loose 35 euros?!! This does not make any sense.
reviews.author: portoadvisor

reviews.title: When not late, flight are canceled ...
reviews.text: This company is the worst I know : planes are regularly late, and sometimes even canceled. When I say late, it is not 10 min... but 3, 4 or more hours !!!! If you plan to use it : delay or change your schedule, try something else, UTair for example is quite better.
reviews.author: Ed D

reviews.title: Local russian airline carrier, rather good and convenient
reviews.text: We often fly by Rusiine jets, primarily for business purposes. Good carrier, has pretty fast and comfortable Bombardier CRJ aircrafts, perfert service, professional crews. Electronic tickets and boarding passes are easily selectable and processed. Short flights don't provide any food, just beverages - juices, water. No TV, movies, entertainment, USB outlets. Legroom is spaced enough, seats are comfortable. Rusline sometimes cancels its flights, as most companies do, but it's not quite often, really, so the stats about it rather good.
reviews.author: Serge M

reviews.title: Reliable Russian regional company using small Bombardier aircrafts
reviews.text: Small reliable company using small Bombardier and Embraer aircrafts. Our flights were on time. Flying time 1 hour 50 minutes. Service on board quite standard. Coffee, tea, juices and sandwiches. Stewardess spoke good English and was helpful and service minded. RusLIne has many domestic Russian destinations fra St Petersburg. Ticket prices slightly on the expensive side. St Petersburg Polkova airport is modern, efficient and inviting. Visa control waiting time is short.
reviews.author: Dag W

reviews.title: Our first experience to our great pleasure
reviews.text: We always like to try something new, and opted for yet another independent travel. Glad we did, as it seems most people from here prefer the 'safe' tour organisers and go in groups. So much the better as we met with the locals already on the flight. 3/4 full plane meant stewardess had time for us all. Sursprised that our economy tickets allowed for luggage so we didn't have to drag things on board. Western airlines should know this, and remember, that once they too...but now we have to pay. I call that service! Also, on western flights: nothing of either drinks or food included. And here: drinks, and a choice of sandwiches presented by a very sweet air hostess who was the sole attendant on the filght. Thank you RusLine, and may we see you again soon!
reviews.author: 1Norwegian

reviews.title: Major schedule change
reviews.text: They canceled the evening service only a couple of days in advance and I got offered a flight several hours earlier. Furtunately, they answer to e-mails quite fast in English. The flight itself was on-time and average. Despite being the most expensive airline between the two cities (but the only one flying to DME), they only served something to drink.
reviews.author: Niels T
